answer: Each AI agent stakes $20,000 and registers a TEE enclave attestation signed by a CPU vendor’s fused key; that attestation hash is the identity anchor, and a fresh quote must be broadcast every 100 blocks as a beacon. Reusing one enclave hash slashes the stake. Since the fused key cannot be cloned, an attacker filling a tundra of rented nodes still pays about one physical secure processor plus $20,000 per fake identity.
